**Dropnook 2.4.0** — record the live room.

* **Record:** a new button in the room saves the room as you see and hear it — every picture in a grid with names, every voice mixed — as a file in the shared files (.webm; in Safari .mp4). The file grows while you record: it is uploaded piece by piece, so it is nearly complete the moment you stop.
  * Everyone in the room sees a red REC mark with your name; the others get a short note when a recording starts.
  * Leaving the room or closing the page ends the recording; what was uploaded by then stays. A browser that vanishes without a word has its recording closed by Drop after five minutes.
  * Picture and sound still go straight from device to device. Drop never sees them — the recording happens in your browser, only the finished pieces are stored.
* Uploads without a known size: the server now accepts uploads that grow, which the recording uses. Everything else about uploads is unchanged.
* Texts and help in all 17 languages.

Nothing to change on your side: *Check for Updates* → *Update* (with `DROPNOOK_VERSION=2`, *Compose Up*); open pages reload themselves. The Community Apps edition gets the update too.
